tldr: Moon in the 1st house routes emotional safety through selfhood and embodiment.
body: With the Moon in the 1st house, emotional needs, instinct, memory, care, and the search for safety move through identity, body, presence, and first response to life. This makes how you enter the room, claim space, and let the world meet you a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become emotional intelligence, responsiveness, intuition, and the ability to nurture what this house governs. Left unconscious, it can become mood-driven choices, over-attachment, defensiveness, or letting old emotional patterns run this area.
gift: emotional intelligence, responsiveness, intuition, and the ability to nurture what this house governs expressed through selfhood and embodiment.
challenge: mood-driven choices, over-attachment, defensiveness, or letting old emotional patterns run this area concentrated in selfhood and embodiment.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
